cohort: Pregnancies with hypoplastic left and right heart (HLHS and HRH) single ventricle cardiac defects (SVCD)
finding: The study found that while maternal-fetal comorbidities were common in both HLHS and HRHS, earlier gestational age at delivery and oligohydramnios were the only significant predictors of lower postnatal survival at one year.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery occurred in 37% of pregnancies with single ventricle cardiac defects, with no difference in rates between hypoplastic left and right heart subtypes.
